speaker: narrator
text: Part two. Millbrook's money now *melts* every day.

speaker: narrator
text: Morning. The whole town reads the *rule*.

speaker: boss
text: Keep it, and you lose it. So *spend it*!

speaker: narrator
text: And Millbrook *spends*.

speaker: narrator
text: By ten a.m., Mia's bakery has a *line*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay! I sold *forty cakes*! Forty!

speaker: narrator
text: Theo, age nine, spends everything on *candy*.

speaker: kid
text: It was melting! It's *science*!

speaker: narrator
text: The barber hires a helper. The helper buys *shoes*.

speaker: narrator
text: The shoe shop buys *paint*. The painter buys bread.

speaker: bit
text: One dollar changed hands *nine times* today.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, it's *working*. The town is alive!

speaker: narrator
text: Only Grandpa Lou still sleeps on his *mattress*.

speaker: scientist
text: I'm not spending. I'll *outlast* it.

speaker: narrator
text: At noon, Mia looks at her flour *price*.

speaker: friend
text: Flour was five dollars. Now it's *eight*.

speaker: hero
text: Why? Nobody even made more *flour*.

speaker: bit
text: Everyone is buying. Nobody is *waiting*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. When money melts, things get *expensive*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part three drops in two days.
